newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Bank of Baroda cuts prime rate.
newsitem.headline: India's Bank of Baroda cuts prime rate.

text.p: State-run Bank of Baroda said on Monday it cut its prime lending rate to 13.5 percent per annum from 14 percent with effect from July 1.
The maximum spread over the prime rate remains unchanged at four percentage points, the bank said in a statement.
The cut in the prime lending rate follows a one percentage point cut in a key bank rate announced by the Reserve Bank of India last week.
Other leading banks, including the State Bank of India have already cut their prime lending rates.
